reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab report for the exact batch plus a money-back guarantee makes one box at $24.99 an easy trial. I would only buy the first box at the launch price, not two.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And at about $0.83 to $1 a day I can probably find cheaper bisglycinate elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price per day, around $0.60, or a clear explanation of why bisglycinate alone is enough for low magnesium.
